description: The MIRACO Pro is a handheld 3D scanner that works on its own, without a computer or cables. It captures real objects as digital 3D models that you can use for reverse engineering, CAD reference or 3D printing. Near mode picks up fine detail on small parts, and far mode quickly covers large objects such as vehicles or people. You can scan and process models on its built-in touchscreen, then export STL or OBJ files.

specs.label: Technology
specs.value: Quad-camera infrared structured light (Class 1 infrared light source)

specs.label: Single-frame accuracy
specs.value: Up to 0.05 mm (near mode); up to 0.3 mm (far mode)

specs.label: Battery and weight
specs.value: Internal 5000 mAh battery, up to 2 h of scanning; 750 g

materials: Solid, non-reflective objects from 10 mm up to 4 m
Shiny, see-through or very dark objects (need scanning spray first)
useRestrictions: Do not shine the scanner into anyone's eyes for long periods (Class 1 infrared light), and warn subjects before scanning because the flashing lights may not be suitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy.
